_comment: Defect declarations for the showcase replay clip (demos/showcase.json); see demos/README.md, Sidecar declarations. Since a router's men stopped holding an engaged front and anchoring the block on it (#1785), the same scan from the divergence (tick 941) reads 3.82 wu, so the exemption went stale and was removed. A scrambled block reforming by array index on a new order is still tracked in #1791.
